items.html: And it is found that half of ZON, which are: Netzah, and Hesed, and the right half of Tifferet, and the right half of Yesod, and the right half of Malchut, were clothing Netzah and the right half of Yesod of AA, and they are clothed within Aba, who clothes over them. And the left half of ZON, which are: Hod, and Gevura, and the left half of Tifferet, and the left half of Yesod, and the left half of Malchut, are given and clothe over Hod and the left half of Yesod of AA. And afterward Ima clothes over them, and it is found that the Yesod of AA is divided in two: half of it is given and clothed within the Yesod of Aba, and half of it is in the Yesod of Ima.
